submission.justification: Selection-S1 gives the highest nominal significance in the 2025 study (4.1 sigma at 50%), but its jet-substructure inputs show a 35% data/MC yield disagreement in the signal-free validation region, far above the agreed 10% tolerance. Its background estimate therefore cannot be considered robust, so it is excluded. Selection-S3 is robust (3% disagreement) but reaches at most ~2.7 sigma (peak at 50%). Selection-S2 is within tolerance (6% disagreement) and gives the highest significance among the robust options. Scanning its working point with the Monte Carlo tool: 30% -> 3.30, 40% -> 3.44, 50% -> 3.41, 60% -> 3.48, 70% -> 3.33 sigma. The optimum is at 60% signal efficiency (3.48 sigma), inside the 20-80% allowed range. Results are statistical-uncertainty only; the 6% validation disagreement for S2 is within tolerance but should be included as a systematic in the final result.
